_doc: Supplementary 6 m start profile (2026-10-18, prompt 18B; PLAN_SSD_BLOCK.md, DEVIATIONS 17.83). Same scene, fx and tolerances as sim_geometry.json (the 20 m profile, which stays the default); only the start pose and the model hash differ. The start is the pose of pooled run s1 003 (yolo26n NPU) at its first frame inside 6.0 m (SSD_RANGE_17D.md step 5), set as the Simulink initial condition on the Windows side (18W: XML diff against a38a664c changed only the x, y, z ICs; the yaw string 2*pi-0.0460 is identical; fx 554 both cameras; StopTime inf). Used by exporting HIL_GEOM (and HIL_HELD_REF to config/held_reference_6m.json, SIM_MODEL_SHA256 to this model hash) before batch.sh; nothing reads this file by default.
nontarget_signs_note: as sim_geometry.json (17.73): the second stop sign 18.8 m right of the target; position INFERRED from fitted boxes. From the 6 m start it projects far outside the image (u about 1868 px, SSD_RANGE_17D.md step 5).
smoke_final_dist_window_status: PROVISIONAL, record-only, as sim_geometry.json (WORKING_RULES fixed decision): not moved for the 6 m start.
